Case Linking now requires e-mail or text verification

Case linking: Case Linking is available and requires two-step verification.

Customers will use the email address or phone number associated to their case details to link to their case through BenefitsCal.

Two-Step Verification is now required

Two-Step Verification: For security of customer information, BenefitsCal now requires two-step verification. Customers will now be asked to enter the one-time code sent to their email address or phone number on file to access BenefitsCal. Once the code is entered on the page, the user will be able to access their case information.

If a user receives a passcode and they were not logging in to BenefitsCal, they must go to BenefitsCal and change their password.

03/02/2023

CalFresh Expedited Services Information

You may be eligible for CalFresh within 3 days of submitting your application if you meet one of the following:

1. Your household has $150 or less in gross monthly income and $100 or less in liquid resources 

2. Your combined income and liquid resources are less than your monthly rent, mortgage, and utility costs

3. Someone in your household is a migrant or seasonal farmworker who is destitute and has liquid resources of $100 or less.

After you apply, you’ll have an interview within 3 days.

If you qualify for CalFresh, you will get your benefits beginning from the date of your application. 

Helpful Information:

- Gross income is all the money you make before taxes and/or deductions are taken out.

- Examples of liquid assets are cash on hand, money in your bank accounts, stocks or bonds, and one-time payments.

Welcome to BenefitsCal.

We’re here to support you with food, cash aid, and health coverage benefits.

What do you want to do today?

Apply for benefits

Learn more about food, cash aid, and health coverage programs

Manage my benefits

Upload documents, submit renewals, and more

Set up an account as a Community Based Organization

Explore support and BenefitsCal resources

I want to apply for benefits.

Ready to apply?

Benefits help millions of Californians to stay healthy and care for their families. We’re here to support you through the process.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application.

Want to learn more about benefits?

Find the programs that are right for you and your family or see what you might be eligible for.

Are you a student? Visit our Student Center!

What programs are available?

Great question. Find the programs that are right for you and your family.

Food

Add to your food budget and get help putting healthy food on the table with the CalFresh Program.

Learn more about food programs

Cash Aid

Learn more about cash aid

Health Coverage

Get health care for your family including for children and seniors. Care also covers people with a disability, foster care, and pregnant women. Additionally, there's coverage for people with diseases such as tuberculosis, breast cancer, or HIV/AIDS

Learn more about health coverage

Other Resources

Learn how your family can get help with shots (immunizations), family planning, and money to buy healthy foods.

Learn more about other resources

I want to manage my benefits.

Want to create an account?

With an account, you can stay on top of your benefits and requirements.

View your benefits details

This includes program status, benefit amount, and other case details.

Read electronic notices

These have the same information sent to you in the mail.

Track statuses and reminders

See where you are in the review process and get reminders of upcoming deadlines.

Submit documents, reports, and renewals online

Keep up with required reporting and report changes online.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application or an existing case. These can include your renewal, periodic report, forms of verification, and more.



I want to set up an account as a Community Based Organization.

Community Based Organizations (CBOs) help people apply for and manage their benefits.

These organizations can include:

  • Non-profit organizations
  • Community centers
  • Hospitals
  • Advocacy organizations
  • Food banks
  • Schools/colleges
  • Homeless shelters
  • And more

With a CBO account, organizations can:

  • Submit applications
  • Upload documents
  • Generate reports
  • And more

Learn more about what CBOs can do on BenefitsCal.

If you manage a CBO and want to use BenefitsCal, request your CBO Manager account through your county below.




I want to explore support and BenefitsCal resources.

Where can I learn about managing my benefits online?

Go to Help Center for FAQs and more

SSA

SSA

How can I learn to use BenefitsCal?

Watch How-to Videos on setting up your account, uploading documents, submitting reports, and more.

Watch How-to Videos

How can I contact my county?

Find an office

Where can I find a no-fee ATM for my EBT card?

Find an ATM  

Do you need support with mental health?

CalHOPE provides help with stress, anxiety, depression, and other mental health issues. You can get help online, in-person, and over the phone.

Go to the CalHOPE website  

Are you or is someone you know struggling with mental health or in crisis?

Call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. The crisis counselors are here to listen and support you.

Learn more about 988  

What is Covered California?

Covered California is a free service that connects Californians with brand-name health insurance under the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.

Go to the Covered California Website  

Are you pregnant or have children?

The Women, Infants and Children (WIC) program can provide additional money to buy healthy food, help for breastfeeding moms, and help to find medical care.

Go to the WIC website

BenefitsCal

BenefitsCal is a portal where Californians can get and manage benefits online. This includes food assistance (CalFresh) formerly food stamps, cash aid (CalWORKs, General Assistance, Cash Assistance Program for Immigrants), and affordable health insurance (Medi-Cal).

03/02/2023

CalFresh Expedited Services Information

You may be eligible for CalFresh within 3 days of submitting your application if you meet one of the following:

1. Your household has $150 or less in gross monthly income and $100 or less in liquid resources 

2. Your combined income and liquid resources are less than your monthly rent, mortgage, and utility costs

3. Someone in your household is a migrant or seasonal farmworker who is destitute and has liquid resources of $100 or less.

After you apply, you’ll have an interview within 3 days.

If you qualify for CalFresh, you will get your benefits beginning from the date of your application. 

Helpful Information:

- Gross income is all the money you make before taxes and/or deductions are taken out.

- Examples of liquid assets are cash on hand, money in your bank accounts, stocks or bonds, and one-time payments.

Welcome to BenefitsCal.

We’re here to support you with food, cash aid, and health coverage benefits.

I want to apply for benefits.

Ready to apply?

Benefits help millions of Californians to stay healthy and care for their families. We’re here to support you through the process.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application.

Want to learn more about benefits?

Find the programs that are right for you and your family or see what you might be eligible for.

Are you a student? Visit our Student Center!

What programs are available?

Great question. Find the programs that are right for you and your family.

Food

Add to your food budget and get help putting healthy food on the table with the CalFresh Program.

Learn more about food programs

Cash Aid

Learn more about cash aid

Health Coverage

Get health care for your family including for children and seniors. Care also covers people with a disability, foster care, and pregnant women. Additionally, there's coverage for people with diseases such as tuberculosis, breast cancer, or HIV/AIDS

Learn more about health coverage

Other Resources

Learn how your family can get help with shots (immunizations), family planning, and money to buy healthy foods.

Learn more about other resources

I want to manage my benefits.

Want to create an account?

With an account, you can stay on top of your benefits and requirements.

View your benefits details

This includes program status, benefit amount, and other case details.

Read electronic notices

These have the same information sent to you in the mail.

Track statuses and reminders

See where you are in the review process and get reminders of upcoming deadlines.

Submit documents, reports, and renewals online

Keep up with required reporting and report changes online.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application or an existing case. These can include your renewal, periodic report, forms of verification, and more.



I want to set up an account as a Community Based Organization.

Community Based Organizations (CBOs) help people apply for and manage their benefits.

These organizations can include:

  • Non-profit organizations
  • Community centers
  • Hospitals
  • Advocacy organizations
  • Food banks
  • Schools/colleges
  • Homeless shelters
  • And more

With a CBO account, organizations can:

  • Submit applications
  • Upload documents
  • Generate reports
  • And more

Learn more about what CBOs can do on BenefitsCal.

If you manage a CBO and want to use BenefitsCal, request your CBO Manager account through your county below.

Do you need support with mental health?

CalHOPE provides help with stress, anxiety, depression, and other mental health issues. You can get help online, in-person, and over the phone.

Are you or is someone you know struggling with mental health or in crisis?

Call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. The crisis counselors are here to listen and support you.

What is Covered California?

Covered California is a free service that connects Californians with brand-name health insurance under the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.

The Women, Infants and Children (WIC) program can provide additional money to buy healthy food, help for breastfeeding moms, and help to find medical care.

03/02/2023

CalFresh Expedited Services Information

You may be eligible for CalFresh within 3 days of submitting your application if you meet one of the following:

1. Your household has $150 or less in gross monthly income and $100 or less in liquid resources 

2. Your combined income and liquid resources are less than your monthly rent, mortgage, and utility costs

3. Someone in your household is a migrant or seasonal farmworker who is destitute and has liquid resources of $100 or less.

After you apply, you’ll have an interview within 3 days.

If you qualify for CalFresh, you will get your benefits beginning from the date of your application. 

Helpful Information:

- Gross income is all the money you make before taxes and/or deductions are taken out.

- Examples of liquid assets are cash on hand, money in your bank accounts, stocks or bonds, and one-time payments.

Welcome to BenefitsCal.

We’re here to support you with food, cash aid, and health coverage benefits.

What do you want to do today?

Apply for benefits

Learn more about food, cash aid, and health coverage programs

Manage my benefits

Upload documents, submit renewals, and more

Set up an account as a Community Based Organization

Explore support and BenefitsCal resources

I want to apply for benefits.

Ready to apply?

Benefits help millions of Californians to stay healthy and care for their families. We’re here to support you through the process.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application.

Want to learn more about benefits?

Find the programs that are right for you and your family or see what you might be eligible for.

Are you a student? Visit our Student Center!

What programs are available?

Great question. Find the programs that are right for you and your family.

Food

Add to your food budget and get help putting healthy food on the table with the CalFresh Program.

Learn more about food programs

Cash Aid

Learn more about cash aid

Health Coverage

Get health care for your family including for children and seniors. Care also covers people with a disability, foster care, and pregnant women. Additionally, there's coverage for people with diseases such as tuberculosis, breast cancer, or HIV/AIDS

Learn more about health coverage

Other Resources

Learn how your family can get help with shots (immunizations), family planning, and money to buy healthy foods.

Learn more about other resources

I want to manage my benefits.

Want to create an account?

With an account, you can stay on top of your benefits and requirements.

View your benefits details

This includes program status, benefit amount, and other case details.

Read electronic notices

These have the same information sent to you in the mail.

Track statuses and reminders

See where you are in the review process and get reminders of upcoming deadlines.

Submit documents, reports, and renewals online

Keep up with required reporting and report changes online.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application or an existing case. These can include your renewal, periodic report, forms of verification, and more.



I want to set up an account as a Community Based Organization.

Community Based Organizations (CBOs) help people apply for and manage their benefits.

These organizations can include:

  • Non-profit organizations
  • Community centers
  • Hospitals
  • Advocacy organizations
  • Food banks
  • Schools/colleges
  • Homeless shelters
  • And more

With a CBO account, organizations can:

  • Submit applications
  • Upload documents
  • Generate reports
  • And more

Learn more about what CBOs can do on BenefitsCal.

If you manage a CBO and want to use BenefitsCal, request your CBO Manager account through your county below.




I want to explore support and BenefitsCal resources.

Where can I learn about managing my benefits online?

Go to Help Center for FAQs and more

SSA

SSA

How can I learn to use BenefitsCal?

Watch How-to Videos on setting up your account, uploading documents, submitting reports, and more.

Watch How-to Videos

How can I contact my county?

Find an office

Where can I find a no-fee ATM for my EBT card?

Find an ATM  

Do you need support with mental health?

CalHOPE provides help with stress, anxiety, depression, and other mental health issues. You can get help online, in-person, and over the phone.

Go to the CalHOPE website  

Are you or is someone you know struggling with mental health or in crisis?

Call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. The crisis counselors are here to listen and support you.

Learn more about 988  

What is Covered California?

Covered California is a free service that connects Californians with brand-name health insurance under the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.

Go to the Covered California Website  

Are you pregnant or have children?

The Women, Infants and Children (WIC) program can provide additional money to buy healthy food, help for breastfeeding moms, and help to find medical care.

Go to the WIC website

03/02/2023

CalFresh Expedited Services Information

You may be eligible for CalFresh within 3 days of submitting your application if you meet one of the following:

1. Your household has $150 or less in gross monthly income and $100 or less in liquid resources 

2. Your combined income and liquid resources are less than your monthly rent, mortgage, and utility costs

3. Someone in your household is a migrant or seasonal farmworker who is destitute and has liquid resources of $100 or less.

After you apply, you’ll have an interview within 3 days.

If you qualify for CalFresh, you will get your benefits beginning from the date of your application. 

Helpful Information:

- Gross income is all the money you make before taxes and/or deductions are taken out.

- Examples of liquid assets are cash on hand, money in your bank accounts, stocks or bonds, and one-time payments.

Benefits help millions of Californians to stay healthy and care for their families. We’re here to support you through the process.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application.

Want to learn more about benefits?

What programs are available?

Learn how your family can get help with shots (immunizations), family planning, and money to buy healthy foods.

I want to manage my benefits.

Want to create an account?

With an account, you can stay on top of your benefits and requirements.

View your benefits details

This includes program status, benefit amount, and other case details.

Read electronic notices

These have the same information sent to you in the mail.

Track statuses and reminders

See where you are in the review process and get reminders of upcoming deadlines.

Submit documents, reports, and renewals online

Keep up with required reporting and report changes online.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application or an existing case. These can include your renewal, periodic report, forms of verification, and more.



I want to set up an account as a Community Based Organization.

Community Based Organizations (CBOs) help people apply for and manage their benefits.

These organizations can include:

  • Non-profit organizations
  • Community centers
  • Hospitals
  • Advocacy organizations
  • Food banks
  • Schools/colleges
  • Homeless shelters
  • And more

With a CBO account, organizations can:

  • Submit applications
  • Upload documents
  • Generate reports
  • And more

Learn more about what CBOs can do on BenefitsCal.

If you manage a CBO and want to use BenefitsCal, request your CBO Manager account through your county below.




I want to explore support and BenefitsCal resources.

Where can I learn about managing my benefits online?

Go to Help Center for FAQs and more

How can I learn to use BenefitsCal?

Watch How-to Videos on setting up your account, uploading documents, submitting reports, and more.

Do you need support with mental health?

CalHOPE provides help with stress, anxiety, depression, and other mental health issues. You can get help online, in-person, and over the phone.

Go to the CalHOPE website  

Are you or is someone you know struggling with mental health or in crisis?

Call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. The crisis counselors are here to listen and support you.

Learn more about 988  

What is Covered California?

Covered California is a free service that connects Californians with brand-name health insurance under the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.

Go to the Covered California Website  

Are you pregnant or have children?

The Women, Infants and Children (WIC) program can provide additional money to buy healthy food, help for breastfeeding moms, and help to find medical care.

All text messages will now come to you from BenefitsCal

You will now receive text messages about your case from BenefitsCal instead of CalSAWS. Any message sent to you from the County will come from text code 72422. If you have any questions, please call 844-859-2100 or visit www.calsaws.org/thlp.

05/31/2024

Case Linking now requires e-mail or text verification

Case linking: Case Linking is available and requires two-step verification.

Customers will use the email address or phone number associated to their case details to link to their case through BenefitsCal.

Here is a link to a Quick Guide on Case Linking.

05/31/2024

Two-Step Verification is now required

Two-Step Verification: For security of customer information, BenefitsCal now requires two-step verification. Customers will now be asked to enter the one-time code sent to their email address or phone number on file to access BenefitsCal. Once the code is entered on the page, the user will be able to access their case information.

If a user receives a passcode and they were not logging in to BenefitsCal, they must go to BenefitsCal and change their password.

CalFresh Expedited Services Information

You may be eligible for CalFresh within 3 days of submitting your application if you meet one of the following:

1. Your household has $150 or less in gross monthly income and $100 or less in liquid resources 

2. Your combined income and liquid resources are less than your monthly rent, mortgage, and utility costs

3. Someone in your household is a migrant or seasonal farmworker who is destitute and has liquid resources of $100 or less.

After you apply, you’ll have an interview within 3 days.

If you qualify for CalFresh, you will get your benefits beginning from the date of your application. 

Helpful Information:

- Gross income is all the money you make before taxes and/or deductions are taken out.

- Examples of liquid assets are cash on hand, money in your bank accounts, stocks or bonds, and one-time payments.

Welcome to BenefitsCal.

I want to apply for benefits.

Ready to apply?

Benefits help millions of Californians to stay healthy and care for their families. We’re here to support you through the process.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application.

Want to learn more about benefits?

Find the programs that are right for you and your family or see what you might be eligible for.

Are you a student? Visit our Student Center!

What programs are available?

Great question. Find the programs that are right for you and your family.

Food

Add to your food budget and get help putting healthy food on the table with the CalFresh Program.

Learn more about food programs

Cash Aid

Learn more about cash aid

Health Coverage

Get health care for your family including for children and seniors. Care also covers people with a disability, foster care, and pregnant women. Additionally, there's coverage for people with diseases such as tuberculosis, breast cancer, or HIV/AIDS

Learn more about health coverage

Other Resources

Learn how your family can get help with shots (immunizations), family planning, and money to buy healthy foods.

Learn more about other resources

I want to manage my benefits.

Want to create an account?

With an account, you can stay on top of your benefits and requirements.

View your benefits details

This includes program status, benefit amount, and other case details.

Read electronic notices

These have the same information sent to you in the mail.

Track statuses and reminders

See where you are in the review process and get reminders of upcoming deadlines.

Submit documents, reports, and renewals online

Keep up with required reporting and report changes online.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application or an existing case. These can include your renewal, periodic report, forms of verification, and more.



I want to set up an account as a Community Based Organization.

Community Based Organizations (CBOs) help people apply for and manage their benefits.

These organizations can include:

  • Non-profit organizations
  • Community centers
  • Hospitals
  • Advocacy organizations
  • Food banks
  • Schools/colleges
  • Homeless shelters
  • And more

With a CBO account, organizations can:

  • Submit applications
  • Upload documents
  • Generate reports
  • And more

Learn more about what CBOs can do on BenefitsCal.

If you manage a CBO and want to use BenefitsCal, request your CBO Manager account through your county below.

Case Linking now requires e-mail or text verification

Case linking: Case Linking is available and requires two-step verification.

Two-Step Verification is now required

Two-Step Verification: For security of customer information, BenefitsCal now requires two-step verification. Customers will now be asked to enter the one-time code sent to their email address or phone number on file to access BenefitsCal. Once the code is entered on the page, the user will be able to access their case information.

If a user receives a passcode and they were not logging in to BenefitsCal, they must go to BenefitsCal and change their password.

CalFresh Expedited Services Information

You may be eligible for CalFresh within 3 days of submitting your application if you meet one of the following:

1. Your household has $150 or less in gross monthly income and $100 or less in liquid resources 

2. Your combined income and liquid resources are less than your monthly rent, mortgage, and utility costs

3. Someone in your household is a migrant or seasonal farmworker who is destitute and has liquid resources of $100 or less.

After you apply, you’ll have an interview within 3 days.

If you qualify for CalFresh, you will get your benefits beginning from the date of your application. 

Helpful Information:

- Gross income is all the money you make before taxes and/or deductions are taken out.

- Examples of liquid assets are cash on hand, money in your bank accounts, stocks or bonds, and one-time payments.

Welcome to BenefitsCal.

We’re here to support you with food, cash aid, and health coverage benefits.

What do you want to do today?

Apply for benefits

Learn more about food, cash aid, and health coverage programs

Manage my benefits

Set up an account as a Community Based Organization

I want to apply for benefits.

Ready to apply?

Benefits help millions of Californians to stay healthy and care for their families. We’re here to support you through the process.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application.

Want to learn more about benefits?

Find the programs that are right for you and your family or see what you might be eligible for.

Are you a student? Visit our Student Center!

What programs are available?

Great question. Find the programs that are right for you and your family.

Food

Add to your food budget and get help putting healthy food on the table with the CalFresh Program.

Learn more about food programs

Cash Aid

Learn more about cash aid

Health Coverage

Get health care for your family including for children and seniors. Care also covers people with a disability, foster care, and pregnant women. Additionally, there's coverage for people with diseases such as tuberculosis, breast cancer, or HIV/AIDS

Learn more about health coverage

Other Resources

Learn how your family can get help with shots (immunizations), family planning, and money to buy healthy foods.

Learn more about other resources

I want to manage my benefits.

Want to create an account?

With an account, you can stay on top of your benefits and requirements.

View your benefits details

This includes program status, benefit amount, and other case details.

Read electronic notices

These have the same information sent to you in the mail.

Track statuses and reminders

See where you are in the review process and get reminders of upcoming deadlines.

Submit documents, reports, and renewals online

Keep up with required reporting and report changes online.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application or an existing case. These can include your renewal, periodic report, forms of verification, and more.



I want to set up an account as a Community Based Organization.

Community Based Organizations (CBOs) help people apply for and manage their benefits.

These organizations can include:

  • Non-profit organizations
  • Community centers
  • Hospitals
  • Advocacy organizations
  • Food banks
  • Schools/colleges
  • Homeless shelters
  • And more

With a CBO account, organizations can:

  • Submit applications
  • Upload documents
  • Generate reports
  • And more

Learn more about what CBOs can do on BenefitsCal.

If you manage a CBO and want to use BenefitsCal, request your CBO Manager account through your county below.




I want to explore support and BenefitsCal resources.

Where can I learn about managing my benefits online?

Go to Help Center for FAQs and more

Do you need support with mental health?

CalHOPE provides help with stress, anxiety, depression, and other mental health issues. You can get help online, in-person, and over the phone.

Go to the CalHOPE website  

Are you or is someone you know struggling with mental health or in crisis?

Call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. The crisis counselors are here to listen and support you.

What is Covered California?

Covered California is a free service that connects Californians with brand-name health insurance under the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.

Go to the Covered California Website  

Are you pregnant or have children?

The Women, Infants and Children (WIC) program can provide additional money to buy healthy food, help for breastfeeding moms, and help to find medical care.

Two-Step Verification: For security of customer information, BenefitsCal now requires two-step verification. 03/02/2023

CalFresh Expedited Services Information

You may be eligible for CalFresh within 3 days of submitting your application if you meet one of the following:

1. Your household has $150 or less in gross monthly income and $100 or less in liquid resources 

2. Your combined income and liquid resources are less than your monthly rent, mortgage, and utility costs

3. Someone in your household is a migrant or seasonal farmworker who is destitute and has liquid resources of $100 or less.

After you apply, you’ll have an interview within 3 days.

If you qualify for CalFresh, you will get your benefits beginning from the date of your application. 

Helpful Information:

- Gross income is all the money you make before taxes and/or deductions are taken out.

- Examples of liquid assets are cash on hand, money in your bank accounts, stocks or bonds, and one-time payments.

Welcome to BenefitsCal.

We’re here to support you with food, cash aid, and health coverage benefits.

What do you want to do today?

Apply for benefits

Learn more about food, cash aid, and health coverage programs

Manage my benefits

Upload documents, submit renewals, and more

Set up an account as a Community Based Organization

Explore support and BenefitsCal resources

I want to apply for benefits.

Ready to apply?

Benefits help millions of Californians to stay healthy and care for their families. We’re here to support you through the process.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application.

Want to learn more about benefits?

Find the programs that are right for you and your family or see what you might be eligible for.

Are you a student? Visit our Student Center!

What programs are available?

Great question. Find the programs that are right for you and your family.

Food

Add to your food budget and get help putting healthy food on the table with the CalFresh Program.

Learn more about food programs

Cash Aid

Learn more about cash aid

Health Coverage

Get health care for your family including for children and seniors. Care also covers people with a disability, foster care, and pregnant women. Additionally, there's coverage for people with diseases such as tuberculosis, breast cancer, or HIV/AIDS

Learn more about health coverage

Other Resources

Learn how your family can get help with shots (immunizations), family planning, and money to buy healthy foods.

Learn more about other resources

I want to manage my benefits.

Want to create an account?

With an account, you can stay on top of your benefits and requirements.

View your benefits details

This includes program status, benefit amount, and other case details.

Read electronic notices

These have the same information sent to you in the mail.

Track statuses and reminders

See where you are in the review process and get reminders of upcoming deadlines.

Submit documents, reports, and renewals online

Keep up with required reporting and report changes online.

Need to upload a document?

Without an account, you can still upload documents for your application or an existing case. These can include your renewal, periodic report, forms of verification, and more.



I want to set up an account as a Community Based Organization.

Community Based Organizations (CBOs) help people apply for and manage their benefits.

These organizations can include:

  • Non-profit organizations
  • Community centers
  • Hospitals
  • Advocacy organizations
  • Food banks
  • Schools/colleges
  • Homeless shelters
  • And more

With a CBO account, organizations can:

  • Submit applications
  • Upload documents
  • Generate reports
  • And more

Learn more about what CBOs can do on BenefitsCal.

If you manage a CBO and want to use BenefitsCal, request your CBO Manager account through your county below.




I want to explore support and BenefitsCal resources.

Where can I learn about managing my benefits online?

Go to Help Center for FAQs and more

SSA

SSA

How can I learn to use BenefitsCal?

Watch How-to Videos on setting up your account, uploading documents, submitting reports, and more.

Watch How-to Videos

How can I contact my county?

Find an office

Where can I find a no-fee ATM for my EBT card?

Find an ATM  

Do you need support with mental health?

CalHOPE provides help with stress, anxiety, depression, and other mental health issues. You can get help online, in-person, and over the phone.

Go to the CalHOPE website  

Are you or is someone you know struggling with mental health or in crisis?

Call or text 988 to reach the Suicide and Crisis Lifeline. The crisis counselors are here to listen and support you.

Learn more about 988  

What is Covered California?

Covered California is a free service that connects Californians with brand-name health insurance under the Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act.

Go to the Covered California Website  

Are you pregnant or have children?

The Women, Infants and Children (WIC) program can provide additional money to buy healthy food, help for breastfeeding moms, and help to find medical care.

Go to the WIC website

BenefitsCal

BenefitsCal is a portal where Californians can get and manage benefits online. This includes food assistance (CalFresh) formerly food stamps, cash aid (CalWORKs, General Assistance, Cash Assistance Program for Immigrants), and affordable health insurance (Medi-Cal).

03/02/2023

CalFresh Expedited Services Information

You may be eligible for CalFresh within 3 days of submitting your application if you meet one of the following:

1. Your household has $150 or less in gross monthly income and $100 or less in liquid resources 

2. Your combined income and liquid resources are less than your monthly rent, mortgage, and utility costs

3. Someone in your household is a migrant or seasonal farmworker who is destitute and has liquid resources of $100 or less.

After you apply, you’ll have an interview within 3 days.

If you qualify for CalFresh, you will get your benefits beginning from the date of your application. 

Helpful Information:

- Gross income is all the money you make before taxes and/or deductions are taken out.
